scope.operator: Finite real-parameter complex-symmetric A=K−ω²diag(m)+iωdiag(d), fixed five-point constant-spacing Dirichlet K; fixed point-source/receiver maps, repeated receivers weighted by multiplicity.
scope.current_certificate: Exact-arithmetic low/complement small-gain and residual-oriented physical-gradient error bounds, evaluated in ordinary floating point with explicitly unverified Gram allowances. Strict upper derivative<0 is pointwise descent only.
scope.possible_repair: Private fixed Richardson field repair using midpoint high-space DST inverse followed by exact reduced low correction; not current public inversion policy.
scope.no_new_activity: No training, predictions, PDE replay, timings, heldout reads/evaluations, source edits, or result mutations performed for this review.

primary_source_matrix.title: A Certified Trust Region Reduced Basis Approach to PDE-Constrained Optimization

primary_source_matrix.boundary: Coercive variational setting differs from this particular complex-indefinite block stability calculation. Retaining the error product and combining certification with refinement/fallback are already established.
primary_source_matrix.falsifier: Compare the proposed directional bound with a direct specialization of its gradient bound under the SAME fields, direction, norms, and valid stability constant. A renaming or norm substitution alone is not a new theorem.

claim_assessment.currently_supported: A reproducible structure-specific implementation of established spectral/coarse stability and inexact physical-adjoint certification ideas, plus a transparent comparative study including abstention and negative full-cost evidence. The exact combination might support a narrow engineering contribution; this review does not establish its priority.
unsupported_broad_claims: First certified descent direction or certification plus fallback
First fast sine/cosine heterogeneous Galerkin assembly
First coarse/FFT Helmholtz repair or learned-plus-numerical solver
Verified floating-point proof from zero observed false certificates
Convergence of private Richardson from gamma>0,tau<1 alone for variable damping
Inversion acceleration or field-geology generalization from static small-grid derivative quality
claim_assessment.current_evidence_keeps_negative: The frozen eight-slice development batch96 certificate has equal-parent mean slice-median cold cost42.513390625ms vs best exact12.063940187ms, 3.52400542×slower; scalar96 65.991661373ms. Batch96 certifies8/8, batch64 0/8. Existing private repair is exploratory train/validation evidence only and has no timing outcome. Neither new literature nor a promising prototype converts these negatives into demonstrated acceleration.

proof_and_measurement_obligations.required: Write a complete exact-arithmetic proposition for real parameters and arbitrary approximate state/adjoint fields. Derive complex-symmetric C=Lᵀ coupling and conjugated Gram norm, receiver multiplicities, coupled adjoint RHS error, all three directional error terms, shared survey direction, and unavailable/stationarity semantics. Explicitly state finite discrete scope and q/P independence.
proof_and_measurement_obligations.beyond_prior_needed: Identify the specific newly computable/tighter constant or implementation regime, rather than reproducing the established error expansion and negative-upper-bound decision.

proof_and_measurement_obligations.required: For fixed fields, direction and valid exact constants, prove oriented component bounds<=generic M bounds using ||Ar^-1 rB||<=a||rB|| and rho<=a*pB; propagate componentwise to the three-term directional bound. Distinguish this elementary specialization from a novel theorem.
proof_and_measurement_obligations.measurement: Use same-field/direction factorial ablations of raw/corrected fields × generic/oriented constants; corrected+generic is missing from the current three-proposal experiment. Do not attribute a changed-direction or changed-field benefit solely to sharper constants.

proof_and_measurement_obligations.required: Before claiming computer-verified certificates, enclose DCT moments, exact coupling Gram domination, norm/eigenvalue/inverse errors, projection/lift, residuals, and final derivative arithmetic. Replace or rigorously justify the engineering PSD shift; use outward rounding or validated matrix-defect bounds with explicit budget.
proof_and_measurement_obligations.measurement: Adversarial constant/nearconstant potentials, near-singular Ar, gamma≈0, tau≈1, repeated receivers and model/frequency scaling; exact/high-precision cross-checks help detect faults but cannot themselves prove universal enclosure.

proof_and_measurement_obligations.required: Derive full setup/query/storage complexity including O(N log N) moment transforms, O(r²) assembly, O(r³) reduced SVD/eigensolves/factors, r inverse columns, receiver columns, every residual stencil and certificate transform. gamma>0 requires all Laplacian modes below ω²max(m) represented; on a fixed physical2D domain coarse rank grows roughly with squared frequency, not constant in a high-frequency scaling claim.
proof_and_measurement_obligations.measurement: Prespecify grids/frequencies/heterogeneity/damping and report all unavailable cases. Measure crossover and setup amortization under changed m; distinguish fixed-domain grid refinement, frequency growth and larger domains. No PML/variable-grid theorem is implied.

proof_and_measurement_obligations.required: Analyze the actual fixed preconditioner and Schur error map below; a valid conditional contraction estimate is classical, not itself proof of algorithmic novelty. Bound the adjoint forcing caused by unfinished state solves, retain actual residuals, and distinguish physical proposal from composite AD derivative.
proof_and_measurement_obligations.measurement: Compare all fixed sweep checkpoints with exact same-M converged and certificate-stopped GMRES; failures/unavailability retained. One source and eight scalar cases cannot establish survey convergence, optimality, or speedup.

proof_and_measurement_obligations.required: A pointwise directional certificate needs separate accepted-step logic and, for a convergence claim, assumptions ensuring sufficient descent, step control, error/fallback progress and valid termination. Projected constraints require the actual feasible direction, not automatically raw negative gradient.
proof_and_measurement_obligations.measurement: Freeze a task and compare full wall time/work to equal objective/gradient/reconstruction targets against strongest direct and iterative controls; include setup, all trial objectives, correction, abstention/fallback, repeated work and model transitions. Use fresh evaluation units after method selection; do not repurpose inspected development or historical tests as pristine.

same_preconditioner_baseline.notation: In orthonormal (B,Q) coordinates A=[[Ar,C],[L,D]], C=Lᵀ; S=D−L Ar^-1 C. Let E=B Ar^-1 Bᵀ and H=Q Tq^-1 Q with Tq diagonal in the omitted sine modes, entries λj−ω²m_mid+iωd_mid.
same_preconditioner_baseline.actual_private_inverse_action: M=E+(I−EA)H. Its block form is [[Ar^-1,−Ar^-1 C Hq],[0,Hq]], Hq=Tq^-1. Thus A M=[[I,0],[L Ar^-1,S Hq]]. This is a classical upper-triangular approximate Schur inverse, not a new general iteration.
same_preconditioner_baseline.coarse_balanced_reduction: After exact coarse correction Bᵀ(q−Au0)=0. Right-GMRES for A M y=r0, u=u0+M y, keeps the first residual component zero and is high-space right-preconditioned Schur GMRES for S Hq. Recompute the actual full residual to control roundoff.
same_preconditioner_baseline.adjoint_warning: The private adjoint action N=E_H+(I−E_H Aᴴ)Hᴴ, E_H=B Ar^-H Bᵀ, solves the appropriate adjoint equation approximately but is generally NOT Mᴴ=E_H+Hᴴ(I−AᴴE_H). Do not substitute one silently or claim an unrolled derivative. Use the exact same N when matching the private adjoint repair.
same_preconditioner_baseline.primary_control: Fixed right-preconditioned unrestarted GMRES (bounded declared restart only when memory requires) for all state RHS, then adjoint RHS built from the converged states, with identical frozen rank, midpoint, cache/factor reuse and initialization as repair. Ordinary GMRES is appropriate while M/N are fixed linear actions; use FGMRES if actions change or use variable/inexact inner tolerances. Report failure or cap hits, never relabel an unconverged iterate exact.
same_preconditioner_baseline.accuracy_and_stopping: Prespecify true unpreconditioned residual criteria and a deterministic tight-reference accuracy ladder, then independently check objective/full physical-gradient error offline. Residual relative accuracy alone does not bound a near-cancelling survey gradient. Also run certificate-stopped same-M GMRES to the SAME descent task, with exactly the same bound and shared aggregate direction, so repair is not compared only against unnecessarily over-solved PDEs. No exact gradient may enter online stopping or winner selection.
same_preconditioner_baseline.paired_sweep_control: To match changing adjoint targets exactly, formulate K=[[A,0],[−W,Aᴴ]], b=[q;−Pᴴd], W=PᴴP, x=[u;lambda]. The private paired sweep is x+=T(b−Kx), T=[[M,0],[N W M,N]]. This fixed block inverse includes the UPDATED-state adjoint target. Right-GMRES on K T with the same initial fields is an optional direct classical control; disclose/prespecify any norm scaling between state and adjoint equations.
same_preconditioner_baseline.residual_dominance_scope: For one fixed linear problem, same fixed inverse action and warm start, unrestarted right-GMRES search contains the k-step unit-Richardson iterate: residual_Richardson=(I−A M)^k r0, so ||r_GMRES,k||2<=||r_Richardson,k||2 in exact arithmetic. The same observation applies to fixed coupled K,T. It does NOT assert better directional bounds, gradient cosines, finite-step behavior, runtime or dominance across restarts. GMRES orthogonalization and storage are paid.
same_preconditioner_baseline.other_required_controls: Best exact source/receiver/residual-coded route using the existing selector; sparse direct factorization reused for all RHS/frequencies at the same m; same-preconditioner GMRES is mandatory before a fast-repair claim. A scalable Helmholtz claim further requires a credible deflated/shifted-Laplacian or matrix-free solver, not unpreconditioned GMRES. Block/recycled multiple-RHS variants are strong secondary controls if their setup is paid and chosen without heldout tuning.
same_preconditioner_baseline.cost_reporting: Separate constructor/setup vs changed-model query, factor/moment reuse vs cold work; charge POD projection/lift and offline basis costs under declared amortization, DST/DCT, stencil applications, reduced RHS/dispatches, all norms/certificate solves, Krylov orthogonalization/memory, stopping checks, failed attempts/fallbacks and objective trials. Equal-parent matched repetitions with fixed threads/hardware; exact controls may reuse every mathematically legal factor/cache too.

conditional_repair_algebra_not_new_theor.status: Read-only exact-arithmetic derivation; not implemented, evaluated, or asserted novel.
conditional_repair_algebra_not_new_theor.forward_map: On the coarse-balanced error manifold eB=−Ar^-1 C eQ, eQ_next=(I−Hq S)eQ. For residuals rQ_next=(I−S Hq)rQ.
conditional_repair_algebra_not_new_theor.sufficient_bound: h=max_omitted_j 1/|λj−ω²m_mid+iωd_mid|; epsV=max_grid_j |−ω²(mj−m_mid)+iω(dj−d_mid)|; chi=h*(epsV+ell*k). Since S−Tq=Q diag(V−Vmid) Q−L Ar^-1 C, ||I−Hq S||<=chi, with analogous adjoint fixed-RHS bound. chi<1 is a sufficient condition.
conditional_repair_algebra_not_new_theor.limits: The code’s gamma>0,tau<1 proves its residual-to-error stability construction, not this variable-damping repair contraction condition by itself. Updated-state adjoint forcing needs a coupled error recurrence; convergence of state alone is insufficient to assert the same scalar contraction for paired fields. The standard Schur/Neumann argument is prior linear algebra, and a useful theorem would need a precisely scoped, justified new advantage.

prospective_falsification_decisions: If identical-field oriented bounds offer negligible improvement over specialized prior bounds, report an implementation comparison rather than a new certificate theory.
If same-M certificate-stopped GMRES matches or beats fixed repair on total cost at equal certifiability/accuracy, reject a special fast-repair advantage; a useful preconditioner may still remain.
If pure low-mode initialization matches POD-warm-start repair after charging POD cost, reject a learned/POD necessity claim.
If low-rank certificates lose applicability at higher frequency/heterogeneity or reduced r³ cost dominates exact, publish the boundary; do not drop unavailable points or select easiest blocks.
If floating-point counterexamples violate a purported numerical bound, retain the negative and limit guarantees to exact-arithmetic derivation until a validated enclosure is built.
If derivative quality improves but matched-cost accepted inversion progress does not, retain a derivative-quality/certification contribution and reject acceleration claims.
research_status: Targeted primary literature review complete within inspected sources. No exhaustive systematic search or external expert validation claimed.
